summary.text: LaVeta Davenport, a Green Party candidate who, according to Ballotpedia, is the founder of a nonprofit organization, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Michigan's 1st District to Jack Bergman.
She advanced from the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Davenport as the founder of Levadeh, a nonprofit organization that focuses on health, education, relationship and ownership.
In an October 2026 WCMU interview, she said the nonprofit she runs works to improve quality of life in the community.
She received 0.2% of the vote to Jack Bergman's 53.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
